title: game/underground.json
description: The underground (B11, B11b): the rock layers and their pockets, the bedrock floor, the caves, the entrances' passages, the lava, the ores, the cave linings and the surface rock. Loaded by UndergroundData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); UndergroundValidator checks the values (block names the game has, a dither in order, bands that peak inside their range, passages wide enough to walk with steps of one block).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

strata.description: The rock layers: stone down to ditherToY, deep rock below ditherFromY, a dithered change between, blobs of other rock in the stone.

ditherFromY.description: The y below which the rock is always deep; the dither starts here.

ditherToY.description: The y from which the rock is always stone; the dither ends here.

blobLattice.description: The spacing, in blocks, the blob noise is sampled at and interpolated from.

blobs.description: Pockets of other rock; the first row whose noise passes its threshold, at a height inside its band, over a base rock it replaces, wins.

cell.description: The noise's first octave's cell across, in blocks.

cellY.description: The noise's first octave's cell up, in blocks.

threshold.description: The noise value, in thousandths, above which the blob is: higher is rarer.

in.description: The base rocks the pocket may replace (the layer's stone when absent).

minY.description: The lowest y the pocket reaches (the world's bottom when absent).

maxY.description: The highest y the pocket reaches (the world's top when absent).

floor.description: The unbreakable floor: a ragged layer from bottomY up.

caves.description: Cheese caverns and spaghetti tunnels on a coarse lattice, and the rules that keep them clear of the ground, the water and the valley.

latticeXz.description: The lattice spacing across, in blocks.

latticeY.description: The lattice spacing up, in blocks.

topY.description: The highest y a cave reaches.

surfaceCover.description: The blocks of rock kept between a cave's top and the ground (an entrance cuts through it).

cheese.description: The caverns: one noise above a threshold that rises with height, so they lie deep.

deepThreshold.description: The threshold, in thousandths, at and below deepY.

shallowThreshold.description: The threshold at and above shallowY (not below the deep one; 1000: none).

spaghetti.description: The tunnels: two noises both within thickness of zero.

thickness.description: How far from zero, in thousandths, each noise may be: the tunnel's width.

underRegionCeiling.description: The highest y a cave reaches under an authored region (its own chunks start at 0); -1 lets the caves meet the valley's own.

waterMargin.description: Blocks round a water cell that stay solid.

bedClearance.description: Blocks under the bed of a water column that stay solid (not below waterMargin).

entrances.description: Passages a body walks down from the surface into the caves: sites of cell blocks, a share of which open a straight stair of width blocks (headroom of air above the floor, one block down every run blocks along) from a mouth inside the site, in the direction whose ground covers it best, until it meets a cave at least minDrop under the mouth, then a landing. Only on dry procedural land clear of water, river banks, regions and their margin; the first rimLength blocks stand in a rim of rock.

chance.description: The share of the sites that try to open a passage, in thousandths.

margin.description: How far inside its site the mouth lies, in blocks.

attempts.description: How many spots a site tries; the passage the ground covers most (a hillside over level ground) wins.

minHeightAboveSea.description: How far over the sea the ground at the mouth must be.

waterReach.description: Columns round the passage that hold no water, river carve or lake (above the caves' waterMargin).

headroom.description: The air above the floor, in blocks.

run.description: The blocks along the passage for each block it drops (a step is one block).

minDrop.description: How far under the mouth the passage must reach a cave.

maxLength.description: The longest passage, in blocks along (at least minDrop x run).

landing.description: The level blocks after the passage meets its cave.

rimLength.description: The blocks of the passage, from the mouth, framed by the rim.

rimWidth.description: How wide the rim is round the passage, in blocks.

rimBlocks.description: The rocks of the rim, drawn by weight.

lava.description: Cave air at or below level is lava.

level.description: The highest y that holds lava.

valley.description: B13: how far the underground reaches into the valley's own stone. Every distance is in blocks and measured as a cube (the largest of the three axes).

surfaceDistance.description: How far a changed block stays from any air cell of the valley.

waterDistance.description: How far a changed block stays from any water cell (not under surfaceDistance).

borderMargin.description: Columns in from the valley's edge where nothing changes.

siteMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from a site's level ground, a named point, an NPC or the spawn.

pathMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from a trodden path.

propMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from a block of a prop.

villageSite.description: The site the village stands round (a site of the scene).

villageMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from the village's footprint (the site's level ground and blend).

passPaths.description: The paths of the pass (names of paths of the scene).

passProps.description: The props of the pass (names of props of the scene), the rockfall.

passMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from the pass's paths and props.

id.description: The row's id (lowercase kebab-case): also the key of its random draws.

replaces.description: The rocks its veins may replace; no other block is ever replaced.

min.description: The fewest blocks a vein tries to hold.

max.description: The most blocks a vein tries to hold.

minY.description: The lowest y of the band.

maxY.description: The highest y of the band.

peakY.description: The y the triangular spread of vein centres peaks at (inside the band).

veins.description: Veins tried in a chunk column (16 x 16 blocks, every layer).

linings.description: Rules laid over the rock a cave exposes, in order, the first that applies winning: gravel and loose stone on floors, mossy stone near an entrance's passage (damp) and near water (wet), sand and gravel where the cave lies near water.

wetReach.description: Columns from a water column that count as near water.

dampReach.description: Blocks from an entrance's passage that count as damp.

face.description: Which exposed face of the rock: floor (air above), wall (air at the side), ceiling (air below).

chance.description: The share of the qualifying cells, in thousandths.

surfaceRock.description: Bare and loose stone on the surface: banded rock on cliff faces, gravel scree on steep ground and at a cliff's foot, gravel in river beds and on their banks. Snow and the biome's grass elsewhere are unchanged.

drop.description: How far a column stands over its lowest neighbour (water counts as its surface) to be a cliff column.

bandThickness.description: The thickness of one band, in blocks.

zoneCell.description: The size of the zones that draw their bands apart, in blocks.

tilt.description: How far the bands rise and fall across a face, in blocks.

bands.description: The rocks of the bands, drawn by weight.

steepDrop.description: How far a column stands over its lowest neighbour to be steep (under the cliff's drop).

footReach.description: Columns from a cliff column the foot reaches.

chance.description: The share of the qualifying columns, in thousandths.

minWeight.description: How much a river must have carved a column, in thousandths of its full carve.

chance.description: The share of the qualifying columns, in thousandths.

blockName.description: A block's name (lowercase, words joined by a hyphen) as BlockDefinition has it.

patch.description: A patchy mask: a fractal noise that must pass a threshold, so a rule lays its block in clumps.

cellY.description: The cell up (underground only; the cell when absent).

threshold.description: The noise value, in thousandths, above which the rule applies.
